overview_description.description: Lightforce Orthodontics is a fully customized 3D-printed bracket system developer based on the anatomy and tooth morphology of each patient. The company’s mission is to apply modern technology and mass customization to improve the orthodontic experience for both patients and doctors. A first-of-its-kind in the orthodontic space, Lightforce offers a platform for orthodontists and Lightforce technicians to collaborate on treatment plans for each individual patient.

product.name: Fully Customized 3D Printed Braces
product.description: A system of ceramic braces 3D printed to fit each patient's unique tooth anatomy and morphology for orthodontic treatment.

product.name: LightTray Indirect Bonding Trays
product.description: Patient-specific indirect bonding trays designed to accurately and efficiently bond LightForce braces without requiring doctor time.

product.name: LightPlan Software
product.description: A cloud-based digital platform for orthodontists to create, adjust, and approve personalized treatment plans for LightForce braces.

product.name: Face Map 3D Scanning Feature
product.description: A smartphone-based 3D scanning tool integrated into LightPlan to capture patients' facial and smile data for improved treatment planning.
